text:
alex: quick sync — we need to align on transport + routing policy for chat streaming before we lock the roadmap for Q2. customers asking for resume + deterministic finish reasons.
maria: +1. which asks are blocking launch vs nice-to-have?
jonathan: From CS: enterprise customers want websockets for stable connections and proxy control; mobile teams prefer SSE for easy reconnection and battery.
tara: ops perspective: websockets complicate load balancing and autoscaling (sticky connections), SSE scales better w/ our existing gateways.
sahil: also cost note: persistent websocket connections increase LPUs when using Dedicated pools. need to quantify.
alex: thinking tradeoffs: default to SSE for hosted API, websocket as opt-in for Dedicated/private? that lets mobile + proxies use SSE, enterprise get websockets. thoughts?
maria: works but we need clear SDK ergonomics; V1 should hide transport as much as possible. API shape: streaming deltas + finish_reason enum + delta types (text, function_call, metadata).
jonathan: agreed. define finish_reason set: stop | length | timeout | cancel | error. include machine-friendly codes for telemetry.
tara: launch criteria proposal: 1) SSE + chunked JSON deltas implemented 2) Streaming contract doc + SDK example 3) Backpressure strategy documented 4) Basic resume token for short reconnects 5) Fallback to polling for old proxies
sahil: priority ranking: resume token (HIGH), finish_reason determinism (HIGH), websocket optionality (MED), multiplexing multiple streams per conn (LOW).
alex: resume token design: short-lived opaque token returned in final delta and periodically during stream. token lets client resume with last_event_id. security: token scoped to request id and TTL 30s.
maria: can we support resume without server-side KV? we could encode last-majority-kv in token (cursor + cached prefix hash) so stateless resume possible for short windows.
tonks: ops-bot: deploy plan: staging -> limited beta -> GA. will need health metrics (retransmits, resume success rate, avg time-to-first-token).
jonathan: delta format: prefer small payloads: {"type":"delta","delta_type":"text","content":"...","seq":42} for each chunk. include optional patch op for structured output.
tara: backpressure: we should expose a server-provided suggested-window header and allow clients to send `window: N` to indicate buffer. if client exceeds, server will send 429-delta then soft-close.
sahil: for Dedicated latency-sensitive workloads, allow per-route policy to force websockets and give higher LRU for KV caches. but we must warn on capacity docs.
maria: SDK impact: streaming interface should be identical whether SSE or WS. e.g. onDelta(delta) callbacks, onFinish(reason, meta). keep behavior deterministic across transports.
alex: UX question: do we emit partial function_call objects as deltas or wait until complete? customers want early token-level tool-calls to show typing indicators. propose emit partial function_call with a `complete: bool` flag.
jonathan: agree. include `finish_metadata` with optional `resolved_function` object when complete.
tara: logging: every stream event must include route, model, customer_tier, duration, resume_used boolean. add sampling for full payloads.
sahil: can we ship a minimal websocket handshake for Dedicated that mirrors SSE semantics (same delta framings, same seq IDs)? that will reduce SDK branching.
maria: yes — canonical contract = delta + seq + finish_reason. transport is a plumbing detail. docs should be explicit.
alex: launch checklist update: add rollout gates — beta customers (2 large enterprise + 5 mobile apps), latency SLOs 95th <= 200ms TTF first token for hosted, resume success rate >= 95% in beta, SDK parity tests passing.
tonks: ops-bot: noted. created rollout ticket INF-429.
jonathan: edge cases: proxy that buffers SSE until connection close will break streaming semantics; add guidance and a header `X-Stream-Expect: live` that signals intermediaries + CDN hints.
maria: async follow-up: i'll draft the API contract doc with examples for partial function calls, resume token format, and finish_reason enum. aim for draft by EOD Friday.
alex: thanks — next sync Thursday to finalize prioritization and ship shielding for Dedicated customers. :thumbsup:
